text:
Maria R: Heads-up — after yesterday's runtime rollout we're seeing a 20-30% tail latency regression on 2x1/2x2 batching workloads. Attached nsys trace: https://redwood-internal/trace/1912345699 (nsys snapshot).
Tyler B: seeing it locally too. can you paste the top kernel timeline? :eyes:
Maria R: pasted top timeline (trimmed):
```
0.000s - cublasLtMatmul (algo=234)  5.2ms
0.006s - cutlass_gemm_kernel_v1       2.1ms
0.009s - cublasLtMatmul (algo=301)  12.4ms  <-- hot
0.022s - cudaMemcpyAsync             0.3ms
```
Looks like a switch to algo=301 which needs a ~40MB workspace vs algo=234 which used ~4MB.
Jen L: interesting. did algo selection rules change in the last deploy?
ci-bot: perf-regression detected in commit 9f2b7c1 (deploy/runner). Regression trace: https://ci/1912345700.
Sam K: commit 9f2b7c1 diff excerpt:
```
- if (avg_token_len < 32) prefer_small_workspace = true;
+ if (avg_token_len < 32) prefer_small_workspace = false; // favor throughput
```
Tyler B: oof. that flips the heuristic so short sequences now pick big-workspace algos. explains spike on small-batch chat traffic.
Maria R: nvprof excerpt shows fallback path on workspace alloc fail (we saw a few OOM-ish allocations) and a different kernel path executed: "cublasLtMatmul_workspace_alloc -> cublasLtMatmul_launch(algo=301)"
perf-bot: flamegraph + heatmap: https://perf/1912345710 — hotspot is cublasLtMatmul::gemm_kernel at 83% of sample time.
Jen L: two levers: 1) revert that heuristic change, or 2) prefer small-workspace algos for <N tokens but allow occasional throughput algos for long seqs.
Sam K: can also add a soft budget: if workspace > 8MB prefer alternate algorithm; implement as scoring penalty rather than hard flip.
Maria R: also noticed KV cache thrash spikes in same window — clients with many short chats were evicting KV pages -> more recomputation and longer effective sequences hitting matmul. Logs: "kv_cache: evicting shard 7 (12MB) -> miss_rate++"
Tyler B: so combined effect: heuristic flip + kv thrash => more long-matmul runs + big-workspace algos chosen. cumulative reg.
Jen L: plan: revert heuristic in canary, add workspace-budget penalty, and increase KV cache watermark temporarily. canary window tomorrow morning?
Sam K: I'll run a pinned-algo experiment: force algo=234 for a cohort (loadgen) and measure p95. will post numbers in this thread.
Maria R: thx — I'll open a quick PR to revert + add unit test for algo-selection behavior and a config flag for workspace_budget.
ci-bot: created issue PERF-4823 and PR #1456 linked to 9f2b7c1 revert.
Maria R: cool. pushing a perf trace diff after revert + KV bump. schedule follow-up in #eng-runtime sync. :thumbsup:
